tenders.title: RFP for AI-Powered GIS And Digital Twin Deployment in DISCOMs
tenders.tendering_authority: International Solar Alliance (ISA) and Ajmer Vidyut Vitran Nigam Limited (AVVNL)
tenders.scope_summary: Request for Proposal for the appointment of System Integrators (SIs) to implement an advanced AI-powered digital transformation project for power distribution companies (DISCOMs). The project aims to strengthen Distributed Energy Resources (DER) integration through GIS-based Asset Management, Network Analysis, and Load Forecasting solutions, including the creation of digital twins.
key_points: Implement an AI-powered digital transformation project for DISCOMs.
Focus on GIS-based Asset Management, Network Analysis, and Load Forecasting.
Includes deployment of digital twins and advanced analytics capabilities.
Selected SI responsible for end-to-end deployment, software, licensing, updates, and 5 years of O&M.
Environment Setup and hosting within three months (5% payment).
Deployment of mobile application and digital tools within six months (10% payment).
Field surveys and data digitization within six months (20% payment).
Core functional modules (asset management, network analysis) within twelve months (20% payment).
Advanced AI-enabled analytics and digital modules also within twelve months (5% payment).
